title_zh: 把车站地图箭头引向开放入口

scenario.label_zh: 虚构郊区车站的地图引导
scenario.goal_zh: 核对站点与入口位置并约定避免把访客引向施工门

context_zh: 虚构城镇地图设计练习：设计师 Nina 与志愿者 Ash 为郊区火车站更新访客地图。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: This suburban station is situated on the east side of the canal, correct?

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: Yes, but the open entrance is on its south side. Your arrow points to the construction gate.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: I followed the building outline instead of the entrance marker.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: We need the map to steer visitors toward the open entrance, not the fenced gate.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: I’ll move the arrow and add the entrance label beside it.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: Good. I’ll check it against the site diagram before we print.
